items.title: Strive reports $208M in warrant exercises as Bitcoin holdings jump 11%
items.summary: Strive is now the fifth-largest publicly traded corporate Bitcoin holder, with 32,773 BTC, as it continues to expand its treasury through equity financing.

items.title: ‘Leave’: Crypto Backlash Over French Proposal to Report Wallets Over $112K
items.summary: The proposal would require crypto owners to report holdings over €100,000, sparking concerns following a wave of "wrench attacks" in France.

items.title: Metaplanet to issue $329M convertible bonds to pay debt, fund share buybacks
items.summary: Metaplanet plans to issue zero-interest bonds with a five-year maturity to improve its debt structure and cut its reliance on Bitcoin-collateralized loans without selling holdings.
